dialogues.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
dialogues.text: Hey, the flower blossoms today are as beautiful as always.

choices.text: Are you still tending to the flowers?

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: Yea, I actually want to go find more types of flower seeds, so I can plant even more kinds of flowers.

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: By the way, do you know someone named Xavier?

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: What a weird person. He saw the flowers I planted and got really excited, then he ran up to me to ask if he could... what did he call it? I think it was something called "filming"?

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: There was someone that looked like he was from the Shogun's Army with him. I got a little scared and asked what he wanted...

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: He said that he wanted to have the person from the Shogun's Army stand in the flower field and swing his sword to make some kind of "swashbuckler flick."

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: I refused his request in the end, because I didn't want the flowers to be trampled... Man, what a weird person...

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: It's going pretty well, but something feels to be missing. The flowers don't seem to be blossoming as fully as before. I'm not sure if it has something to do with the Mikage Furnace incident.

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: *sigh* I guess the Mikage Furnace did have some sort of effect on the soil surrounding it after all...

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: I've heard that there's someone named Vahid who sells specialty fertilizer in Ritou. It's said to be a local specialty from Sumeru.

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: I'd grown quite interested in those fertilizers, so I got some people to ask around for me.

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: But I've heard them say that the store owner... Vahid, I think his name is — whenever he introduces those fertilizers, all he does is repeat the same lines over and over. He never says anything about the details of how it works, either.

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: That just doesn't seem... How should I say this? It just doesn't seem very reliable, you know?

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: It's okay, there aren't any monsters nearby anyway.

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: Even though there are no monsters about... I did see a strange person when I was out picking flowers.

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: He just sat there staring into space, sword in hand, and he seemed to be mumbling about something...

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: I was a little startled, so I just peeked from a distance before leaving.

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: I'm not sure if he's still there, but he felt dangerous. Best I stay away from him...

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: See you around. Remember to come and take a look at the flowers when you get a chance.
